lead: The handoff's own item text can contradict a settled rule, and the rule still wins — anything in the pack that is status can be stale about a decision.
body: An item asking for a new diagnostic code or a new capability row is usually asking a question the cited `rule:` already answers, and the handoff was written by a session that had not read the section yet. One `bun nv peek <rule>:"## N"` on every section the item cites, *before* writing the row, is the whole check.
